name: astral-charts
description: Deterministic natal astrology calculation and strictly structured interpretation

scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.vendor:astronomia: npm --prefix vendor/astronomia install && npm --prefix vendor/astronomia run build
scripts.vendor:places: npx --yes pnpm@9.0.0 --dir vendor/places install --frozen-lockfile && npx --yes pnpm@9.0.0 --dir vendor/places --filter @countrystatecity/countries build
scripts.vendor:time: npm --prefix vendor/time install && npm --prefix vendor/time exec -- lerna run build-dist --scope @js-joda/core --scope @js-joda/timezone
scripts.vendor:build: npm run vendor:astronomia && npm run vendor:places && npm run vendor:time
